name: pricing-hero
description: Pricing page hero: eyebrow, headline and body copy beside a white card holding the HubSpot quote form. Live: the `.ap-pricing-hero` section on /new-pricing/.

eyebrow.description: Small purple label above the heading.

title.description: Page heading (the page's h1). Line breaks are kept.

body.description: Paragraph under the heading. Line breaks are kept.

form_label.description: Accessible name of the form mount, e.g. Get a Custom Quote.

hubspot_portal.description: HubSpot portal ID (digits). The form card renders only with a portal and a form ID.

hubspot_region.description: HubSpot region, e.g. na1 or na2. Picks the embed script host as well.

form_placeholders.description: Placeholder text per HubSpot field name (lower-case), set once the form is drawn, e.g. {"email":"Work Email*"}.

form_submit.description: Submit button text, set once the form is drawn. Empty keeps HubSpot's.

form_redirect.description: Page to open after a successful submission. Empty keeps HubSpot's own thank-you behaviour.

form_enrich_fields.description: Field names (lower-case) the form hides until the visitor needs them: shown when enrichment (ZoomInfo data-zi-*-enriched) reports it could not fill them, and on submit unless enrichment filled them. Live: phone_entered_by_prospect, phone, firstname, lastname, company.
